comments.content: The log capture and expectation assertion happen AFTER the async search has already completed (the `while (isRunning)` loop finishes before `MockLog.capture` is opened). The subsequent `getRestClient().performRequest(searchRequest)` re-POSTs the original `_async_search` submit request, which starts a NEW async search whose shard failures produce the log lines you're asserting on. That is a very different (and confusing) request than what the test name implies it is validating, and the polling/completion block above is dead work whose result is discarded. Please capture logs before triggering the search you actually intend to assert on (or drop the redundant polling block).

`event.getThrown().getMessage()` can be null (e.g. an exception constructed without a message), which would NPE here. Since `exceptionMessage` is always non-null in current callers this is latent, but consider guarding: `exceptionMessage.equals(event.getThrown().getMessage())` to avoid the NPE and reverse the null-safety.

`clusterService.localNode()` can return null early in the node lifecycle (before the local node is set), which would NPE inside this lambda when a failure is logged. Given this runs on the data node during query execution it's likely always set, but consider null-guarding or documenting the assumption to avoid a surprising NPE in the error path.
